dct_description_sm: The main objective of this study is to investigate relations between plasma concentrations of persistent organic pollutants (and their metabolites) and the amount of thyroid hormones bound to their transport proteins in Inuit women of childbearing age. The secondary objective is to identify the major chemicals other than thyroid hormones that are bound to these proteins.

dct_title_s: Disruption of thyroxine transport by persistent organic pollutants in Inuit women of childbearing age from Nunavik
